snippet.title: Prologue: Go Wayback! - Early Access Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Prologue: Go Wayback! is entering Early Access on November 20!

Survive across countless maps that are generated on your system every time you play, now with even more player freedom.

New features include:
-  Game Modes: Chart your path to the Weather Tower in Go Wayback!, survive for as long as possible in Objective: Survive, or take it easy in Free Roam mode where only fall damage can kill you.
- Custom Game Settings: further customize your run by tweaking the weather, time of day, survival challenge levels, number of items, and more!
- Map Editor: Draw your own maps, or import designs from images to turn into playable worlds.
- Saving: Pause and resume your run!
- Map Seed sharing: Share your favorite map seeds with your friends and the community.

Game Modes are available for testing right now with today's Open Beta update, alongside new flashlight items and visual improvements to the river generation system.

Join our Discord to share your feedback and tell us what features, items, Game Modes and other things you’d like to see in our game!

Wishlist and download the Open Beta Playtest on:
Steam: https://go.pp.studio/GoWaybackSteam
Epic Games Store: https://go.pp.studio/GoWaybackEGS

Socials:
Discord: https://community.pp.studio
X/Twitter: https://x.com/playprologue
Instagram: https://instagram.com/pp_socials
TikTok: https://tiktok.com/@playprologue
